title: Answer: no position on physical time, and conscious events follow the brain events that cause them

statements.text: The view takes no position on what time is. Its temporal claim is that conscious events follow the neural events that cause them and come too late to cause the behavior those events start, as the hot stove and Libet's readiness potential are taken to suggest.

sources.quote: the conscious urge to make a movement comes too late to causally contribute to a movement that has already been initiated by brain processes
